content: tests/uiFidelity.test.ts assertions verified: shortcuts excludes 'ControlRight'; reference contains 'ProjectedStylePanel'; exportWorkspace contains 'includeProjectedViewport' and 'includeProjectedCameraMoveVideo'; packageExport contains 'viewport_projected.png', 'viewport_projected_motion.mp4', and "appearance: 'projected'"; help contains 'Projected Style' and 'double-tap W'; ReferenceWorkspace, ProjectedStylePanel, and CoverageOptimizerPanel exclude 'onApplyPanoramaOrigins'; CoverageOptimizerPanel retains 'data-coverage-apply-capture-a', 'data-coverage-apply-capture', and 'Existing panorama origins are never rewritten'; ShotsWorkspace excludes 'flyCameraRevision' and enforces skip-of-renders-while-flying via useEffect and handleFramingCameraChange; ShotFilmstrip uses aria-hidden and pointer-events-none for decorative dots with WarningPopover for details.

items.text: Fidelity test verified shortcuts, projected style references, viewport/package exports, help text, origin behavior, fly-camera render pausing, and filmstrip accessibility.

evidence.excerpt: expect(coveragePanel).toContain('Existing panorama origins are never rewritten');

items.text: Panorama-origin apply APIs and pair data attributes are removed; capture-only apply attributes and explicit non-rewrite messaging remain.
ShotsWorkspace keeps fly camera preview pause by gating renderShotFrame and handleFramingCameraChange on shotCameraFlying, while removing flyCameraRevision usage.
ShotFilmstrip overlay dots remain decorative with aria-hidden and pointer-events-none, while warning details are surfaced through WarningPopover.
